machine_readable_definition: Median penetration depth over the final 20% of melt-present observations before s=0.90.
caveat: Typical late-active geometry; not designed as a regime maximum.

machine_readable_definition: Maximum valid penetration depth over the complete observed track.
caveat: Retained intentionally to expose isolated peaks; not preferred for persistence.

machine_readable_definition: 95th percentile of penetration depth in the selected analysis interior.
Maximum trailing rolling median depth over a physical-distance window; 50 um primary.
caveat: Persistence is physical-distance based, not timestep based.

machine_readable_definition: Maximum trailing rolling 80th-percentile depth over a physical-distance window.
caveat: Sensitivity candidate, not searched post hoc.

machine_readable_definition: Median penetration depth divided by transverse width over the T0 window.
Maximum valid depth/width over the complete observed track.
caveat: Minimum-width guard is applied; still sensitive to one-frame excursions.

machine_readable_definition: 95th percentile of depth/width in the selected analysis interior.
Maximum trailing rolling median depth/width over a physical-distance window; 50 um primary.
caveat: Primary candidate, not a predetermined winner.

machine_readable_definition: Fraction of adaptive-interior scan distance above a dataset-specific exploratory ratio threshold.
caveat: Outer-training geometry threshold is used for held-out label evaluation.

machine_readable_definition: First normalized position where the 50 um rolling-median ratio exceeds the exploratory threshold.
caveat: Undefined when no persistent high-ratio event is observed.
